tool_schemas.name: findParks
tool_schemas.description: Searches and lists park records matching the provided text query and/or filters (park_code, state/states, designation, status, source), returning results sorted as requested and paged with cursor-based pagination (pass limit to cap the page size and cursor to fetch the next page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter value is invalid (including limit out of range, an unsupported sort, or malformed inputs) or if additional properties are supplied. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to read parks, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Free-text search across park name/full name/description.

state.description: Filter by a single US state/territory code contained in the park's states list (e.g., CA).

states.description: Filter by one or more state/territory codes; matches parks containing any of the provided codes.

designation.description: Filter by park designation (e.g., National Park, National Monument).

limit.description: Maximum number of parks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getParkDetails
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full public detail record for a single park, looked up by park_id or by park_code. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, if park_id does not match the required format, or if unexpected properties are included. Raises NOT_FOUND if no park exists for the provided identifier, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read parks, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getAlerts
tool_schemas.description: Lists alerts, optionally scoped to a park (park_id or park_code) and filtered by category, severity, status, and/or effective_at, returning results sorted as requested and paged with cursor-based pagination (limit + cursor). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, malformed timestamps, invalid limit/sort, or unexpected properties, and NOT_FOUND if a specified park_id/park_code does not resolve to a park. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read alerts, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

park_id.description: Return alerts for a specific park id.

park_code.description: Return alerts for a specific park code.

effective_at.description: Only include alerts effective at this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getVisitorCenters
tool_schemas.description: Lists visitor centers, optionally scoped to a park (park_id or park_code) and filtered by operating status, returning results sorted as requested and paged with cursor-based pagination (limit + cursor). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid park_id format, invalid enum/sort/limit, or unexpected properties, and NOT_FOUND if a specified park_id/park_code does not resolve to a park. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read visitor centers, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

park_id.description: Return visitor centers for a specific park id.

park_code.description: Return visitor centers for a specific park code.

status.description: Filter visitor centers by operating status.

limit.description: Maximum number of visitor centers to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getCampgrounds
tool_schemas.description: Lists campgrounds, optionally scoped to a park (park_id or park_code) and filtered by operating status, returning results sorted as requested and paged with cursor-based pagination (limit + cursor). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid park_id format, invalid enum/sort/limit, or unexpected properties, and NOT_FOUND if a specified park_id/park_code does not resolve to a park. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read campgrounds, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

park_id.description: Return campgrounds for a specific park id.

park_code.description: Return campgrounds for a specific park code.

limit.description: Maximum number of campgrounds to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getEvents
tool_schemas.description: Lists events, optionally scoped to a park (park_id or park_code) and filtered by status, category, and start_after/start_before, returning results sorted as requested and paged with cursor-based pagination (limit + cursor). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid park_id format, malformed timestamps, invalid enum/sort/limit, or unexpected properties, and NOT_FOUND if a specified park_id/park_code does not resolve to a park. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot read events, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

park_id.description: Return events for a specific park id.

park_code.description: Return events for a specific park code.

start_after.description: Only include events starting at or after this timestamp.

start_before.description: Only include events starting before or at this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: National Parks Information Server
metadata.description: This backend stores normalized National Park Service-style content: parks, their public details, and related operational information such as alerts, visitor centers, campgrounds, and events. Primary workflows are read-heavy lookups and listings (find parks, then fetch park-specific related resources
